printed_precision_caps_SI.definition: For an ASCII decimal token including exponent, q is one FULL last printed place after SI conversion, including tokens numerically zero. Use center +/- q, never q/2, never drop zero trailing places; kV and kA scale by 1000 exactly once.
printed_precision_caps_SI.OUT_timestamp_full_last_place: Every part/row retains its own actual center and full-place q<=1ps; no hidden-time precision inference. All six intervals (five timestamps and TIME_native) must have a common intersection; each center also meets2ps nominal grid, row0 exact0. Never replace centers with an interval midpoint.

source_allowance.scope: Configured-grid source identity plus declared libm allowance. Printed TIME quantum/Lipschitz remains diagnostic and proves no hidden internal precision.
source_allowance.DC_allowance_application: Add declared_constant_DC_arithmetic_absolute_V once to source-terminal400 residual and once to bridge400 residual. Never add twice within either gate.

budget_propagation.prefix_energy_precision_bound_note: Under |I|<=440A, |VL|<=900V and q caps, full product/prefix propagation is <2e-7J over80002 segments. Check every actual prefix;1e-5J includes arithmetic/conditioning margin.

candidate_cross_h_continuous_all_windows.mapping: Candidate5us vs qualified fine2.5us, fixed PWL union grid, no time fitting.

discontinuous_quantities.explanation: Different sample intervals smear the same jump over different intervals; cross-h jump PWL max/RMSE is diagnostic. All original samples remain subject to own physics, exact input and same-h comparison.
discontinuous_quantities.cross_h_hard_integrals: Shared-grid limits below, pointwise physics, all four Pg/Qg/Pdc/loss mean limits and every TR-energy prefix remain HARD.
discontinuous_quantities.candidate_shared_limit_derivation: Triangle budget: same-h .002 plus reference self .001V poles/rails or .05V/.05A VL/freshJdc. Apply to every original shared point in all four formal windows AND entire acquisition, including tail.
discontinuous_quantities.reference_shared_scope: Every original shared point in all four formal windows AND entire acquisition, including tail.

mean_feature_limits_all_windows.candidate_same_h: Use same-h point-power gates for Pg/Qg/Pdc and reference_self_abs for same-h loss means.

residual_ratio_to_fundamental.scope: Includes interharmonics, not a standards THD claim.

control_numeric_hard_allowances.meaning: Compatibility at actual logged input centers with full-place q. Not a proof of hidden internal-time intervals; never substitute ideal ticks into formula checks.
control_numeric_hard_allowances.formula_allowance_derivation: Canonical formula remains independent of vendor constants. Actual new FormCodec/generated graph must bind every omega/phase/modulation/ramp literal to the listed exact-or12g forms: literal contribution<=5e-11 over held<=.200000000002s, plus1e-12 sin/operation allowance; total1e-10 is prospective headroom, not a time shift. Carrier graph exact decimal literals plus1e-12 operation allowance. Reject any unproved graph/literal, rather than consume arbitrary headroom.
control_numeric_hard_allowances.held_time_rule: For row i, j=(i//gate_stride)//20. abs(held_center-j*100us)<=2ps. At Pulse100=1 the sampler input is actual native TIME at that same row; held/TIME printed intervals must overlap after a declared 1e-15s copying allowance. Between pulses require identical held numeric values, without accumulating drift.
control_numeric_hard_allowances.Pulse100_Pulse5_raw_g_applied_g: Exactly 0 or 1 centers and the prospective integer schedule; no approximate Boolean, time shift, ambiguous-bit fallback or compatibility substitution.
control_numeric_hard_allowances.R_inputs: Exactly .001 or 1e9 ohm centers selected by actual applied g. Closed/open constants, generated conductance assignment and last printed place are archived; Boolean/R exactness is not relaxed by interval propagation.

nominal_margin_design_basis.source: Independent finite integer oracle; regenerate and bind its identity before qualification.
nominal_margin_design_basis.clock_perturbation_bound_formula: Lref*2ps +4000*2ps +1e-9 declared total gate arithmetic/literal guard <9.726e-9, below2.940070679e-5 margin. Formula compatibility uses the separate tighter1e-10/1e-12 additive allowances.
nominal_margin_design_basis.fine_raw_scope: Independent artificial canonical-vs12g control formulas, all80003 fine rows. No bit changes; minimum exceeds the9.726e-9 clock/arithmetic guard. Actual raw intervals and literal/graph identity still must pass; not commercial data.

control_numeric_hard_allowances.raw_comparator_interval_rule: At every original row, including fine midpoints, form actual ref +/- q_ref and carrier +/- q_carrier. For upper=1 require ref_low>=carrier_high; for upper=0 require ref_high<carrier_low. Require actual raw bit equals that strict interval decision and lower=1-upper. Any overlap/indeterminate row is FAIL_UNRESOLVED_SAME_INPUT; never substitute carrier at a previous gate tick.

reference_literal_prior_bound.other_literal_rendering_error: 0 for decimal .85 modulation,50 ramp gain,-.0005 shift,1,3,.5,1000,4 under exact-or12g rendering; binary/libm error is separately allowed1e-12.
reference_literal_prior_bound.generated_graph_obligation: The new actual archived FormCodec output and generated expressions must independently establish these forms/operation order. This prior bound is not automatic native qualification.

purpose: Prospective complete open-loop reference and candidate acceptance contract. No complete native output or candidate has been qualified by this draft. Root review and an immutable protocol/package/analysis identity freeze are required before execution.

shared_direction_and_timing.Vm: Fresh same MainOut read before own PGB; grid/pole/rails relative to ground, VR/VL drop AC toward bridge; DC source terminal positive minus negative.
shared_direction_and_timing.I: Fresh own CBR read before own PGB; phase AC-to-bridge, DC positive-to-negative source (minus native ownBA).
shared_direction_and_timing.applied_g_R: Actual same-row held gates and resistances entering electrical solve.
shared_direction_and_timing.control: Actual shared100us held TIME and derived references; actual-TIME carrier/raw g; same integer100/5us pulse nets. See control for update order.

control.electrical_index: Rows i=0..expected_rows-1 identify nominal t=i*h; actual TIME_native and every part timestamp center must satisfy abs(center-i*h)<=2e-12s. Index identity does not overwrite actual data.
control.continuous_raw_carrier: triangle(x)=1-4*abs(frac(x)-.5); x=(actual TIME_native_s-.0005)*1000. Use actual TIME and the complete piecewise-continuous triangle at every row, including 2.5us midpoints.
control.upper_gate: At each 5us gate tick, g_u=1 iff canonical r_p>=c_k, lower=1-upper. Hold all six applied g and R at intervening fine midpoints.
control.100us_native_implementation: 10kHz Start0 Mag1 noninterpolated impulse -> Real-to-INT -> shared scalar external-pulse SAMP5(TIME), initial0; its actual OUT drives all ramp and sine references.
control.5us_native_implementation: 200kHz Start0 Mag1 noninterpolated impulse -> Real-to-INT -> one INTEGER pulse net -> six scalar external-pulse SAMP5(rawg) -> same-row R; no bypass/stale array.
fresh_same_row_order: six Ron/Roff products and resistance sums
control.first_row: parameters.initial_conditions must be proved by actual initialization/order. Native TIME and every OUT timestamp center must be EXACT0 at row0 (q is separate). No assumption of old sampler defaults.
control.shared_and_midpoint_hard: All 40002 shared acquisition rows have exactly matching six applied g/R; all 40001 fine midpoints hold preceding 5us g/R. Reference held time, held ref values and actual update/hold sequence are independently qualified. Fine midpoint raw g/carrier may change and must be checked at actual TIME.

All19 native branches:16 teaching electrical components plus3 zero-impedance phase ammeters, exact parameters/topology/initialization from parameters.json; no DC ammeter or DC earth shunt.
Actual generated instance/storage indices/dimensions, pulse INTEGER endpoints, SAMP initializations and same-row control/solve/MainOut order; no alias or bypass.
15 actual Vm and4 fresh own CBR chains before own PGB. DC:negative ownBA -> standard force identity -> own PGB; never old CUR or reconstructed current.
All45 actual INF/Map/writer/PGB names, units, groups, full parameters and bijective actual columns; never assume canonical order.
Fresh unique run/source/input snapshot, native/compiler versions, successful return/completion and normal quit.

Require exact five OUT and INF identities; reject missing/duplicate/extra files, wrong hashes, incomplete mapping/INF. Bind paths before read; reject alias/symlink/run escape/non-OUT JSON confusion. End rebind all bytes. Every pre-admission failure reports zero OUT reads.

numeric_conventions.parser: ASCII finite decimal grammar, exact Decimal centers/full q and exact shape/counts. For each row check each of five timestamp centers against i*h within2ps, each q<=1ps, row0 exact0. Require common intersection of all five timestamp and TIME_native center+/-q intervals; keep original centers/bytes, no snapping. Native TIME also meets its qcap/grid/initial rules. Reject nonfinite/missing/duplicate/nonmonotone data. Actual PWL domain must cover windows, no extrapolation.
numeric_conventions.physical_interval_gate: Propagate all full-place q through operations/products/powers/prefix sums, including zero tokens. Require |residual center|+radius+relevant declared allowance<=limit; report each term. Boolean/R inputs have exact separate rules.
numeric_conventions.source: Configured nominal i*h plus-phase whole triple is HARD with source q and declared sin allowance. Actual-TIME and TIME-q source envelopes are diagnostic only, never a relaxed gate or per-phase family choice.
numeric_conventions.failure_reporting: After valid data/input admission report every independent numerical residual despite a clock/source scalar failure. Invalid shape, nonfinite/qcap/safety or indeterminate raw Boolean may stop with explicit FAIL_DATA_OR_INPUT_ADMISSION; list unavailable downstream checks, never assume PASS or call a canonical-input residual proof of invalid actual input. Conditional predictions follow prerequisites. Result records physical_input_prerequisites_pass. If exact applied_g/actual_R fail, physics computed with canonical G is explicitly diagnostic; upstream input FAIL cannot yield actual-physics qualification.

physical_residual_definitions.variables: e=grid Vm, u=pole Vm, n=negative rail Vm, vp=positive rail Vm, i=AC-to-bridge current, j=direct fresh DC absorbing source current, V=400, Gu/Gl from exact applied g and R; G=Gu+Gl=1000+1e-9, z=1/G, E_p=V*Gu_p/G. All in SI once.
physical_residual_definitions.source_terminal: V_dc_source-400 and bridge vp-n-400 each include own propagated q plus exactly one declared constant-DC allowance. Bridge identity is rank1, not independent rank2 closure.
physical_residual_definitions.initial: i0=0 and u0=0; j0=-3*400/(1e9+.001), not zero; both actual source fresh chain and bridge voltage remain independently required.
physical_residual_definitions.KCL: sum(i); pole: i_p+Gu_p*(vp-u_p)-Gl_p*(u_p-n); DC positive/negative rail: j+sum(Gu*(vp-u)) and j+sum(Gl*(u-n)).
physical_residual_definitions.commonmode: n-mean_p(e_p-E_p-(R+z)*i_p); derive from the source sum, identical RL branches, zero initial sum of currents and pole equations. Not a substitute for three-line KCL/TR/source gates.
physical_residual_definitions.energy: W_k=.5*L*sum(i_p[k]^2). Prefix work D_1..k=sum_segments h/4*sum((VL_new+VL_old)*(i_new+i_old)); residual W_k-W_0-D_1..k for EVERY prefix including acquisition tail. Never trap(VL*i).
physical_residual_definitions.conditional_reduced_TR: Measured-source-driven four-unknown discrete-network TR/Schur prediction: use logged e centers each step, canonical exact g/R,400V and zero initial i. It tests network propagation; it is NOT an independent configured-source oracle. Source-configured hard checks remain separate. Propagate input-token/source uncertainty with the declared sensitivity budget. Any prerequisite failure makes predictions diagnostic, unable to rescue failure.

metric_definitions.windows: All four closed windows, every phase/signal separately, shared boundaries in both windows. No fitting, phase permutation, scaling, shift or sample deletion.
metric_definitions.raw_tail: All acquisition rows/prefixes, including tail, pass precision/time/control/input/physics/same-h gates. Formal statistics use the four fixed windows. Also require same-h acquisition-wide max/RMSE under the same limits.
metric_definitions.PWL_difference: PWL on each own actual time grid; insert fixed window endpoints, form full union knots. Error segment d,a,b has squared integral d*(a*a+a*b+b*b)/3. RMSE=sqrt(sum/T); max at all knots. Both SI and fixed-scale limits apply.
metric_definitions.same_h_original_points: First require nominal-index pairing, each center within2ps and paired centers within4ps. Compare all original values by index, without interpolation across jumps. max covers every original point; PWL_RMSE integrates the ERROR samples on common nominal i*h. This case-specific statistic does not claim continuous jump signals or use the generic continuous-only API.
metric_definitions.W_PWL: Compute W=.5L*sum(i^2) on EACH own original grid, then PWL W and compare. Never interpolate i then square. Mean W-PWL differs from .5L*PWL-current-RMS^2.
metric_definitions.point_power_and_loss: Own point snapshots:Pg=sum(e*i); Qg=1.5*(e_beta*i_alpha-e_alpha*i_beta); Pdc=(vp-n)*j; PR=sum(VR*i); Psw=sum(Gu*(vp-u)^2+Gl*(u-n)^2). Mean=exact PWL snapshot integral/T. Do not interpolate operands before products or substitute R*PWL-current-RMS^2.
metric_definitions.Clarke: alpha=(2/3)*(a-.5*b-.5*c), beta=(2/3)*(sqrt(3)/2)*(b-c); amplitude invariant. Pg uses direct abc dot product to retain any zero sequence. Qg>0 is inductive reactive power absorbed from AC; DC absorb positive.
metric_definitions.continuous_total_RMS: For each phase current PWL: mean=integral(i)/T; RMS=sqrt(integral(i^2)/T); one affine segment integral(i^2)=d*(i0^2+i0*i1+i1^2)/3. Includes DC.
metric_definitions.fundamental: On steady6-cycle window:a=2/T*integral(PWL_i*sin(2*pi*f*t)), b=2/T*integral(PWL_i*cos(2*pi*f*t)); affine-times-sin/cos exact integrals with stable differences/compensated sums. RMS1=hypot(a,b)/sqrt(2); phase=atan2(b,a)deg, absolute-time sine basis. Compare wrapped phase difference; no fit/search.
metric_definitions.fundamental_affine_antiderivatives: On segment slope m: integral i*sin(wt) dt = [-i*cos(wt)/w + m*sin(wt)/w^2]; integral i*cos(wt) dt = [i*sin(wt)/w + m*cos(wt)/w^2]. Evaluate with numerically stable differences; exact cycle boundaries inserted by PWL.
metric_definitions.nonfundamental: sqrt(RMS_total^2-mean^2-RMS1^2); subtract DC. Clamp negative radicand only within1e-12A^2 roundoff, else FAIL_METRIC. Ratio=residual/RMS1; includes interharmonics, not standard THD.
metric_definitions.cycles: Aggregate steady6-cycle features are hard. Also report six individual cycle features with boundaries .1+n/60, n0..6, inserted by PWL; per-cycle values are diagnostic until separately predeclared limits exist.
metric_definitions.phase_and_ratio_prerequisite: RMS1>=1A in EACH compared phase/run, fixed before observing data. If false, phase/ratio cannot be qualified: FAIL_PREREQUISITE, not silently N/A. Total/fundamental RMS and residual RMS remain required.

same_h_candidate_hard_all_windows.exact_inputs: TIME by2ps clock/pair rules; six applied g and six actual R exact at every original row. The32 count includes these13 inputs, not32 analog channels.

Every actual result state:switch and direct i:Vdc source current, frozen direction; no reconstructed commercial current.

Validate the held-reference function actually used, without exposing13 observers. minimal_interface.input: Six pure bool closed(time) callables attached to existing IdealSwitch components, with closed_resistance=.001 and open_conductance=1e-9. No public controller/state/Pulse/SAMP framework.

Reject off-grid time; do not floor a floating time/5us at a boundary. Gate evaluation is pure and independent of call order.

gate_classification.HARD: All applicable mapping/closure/raw identity/count/precision/clock/control/source/safety/physical residuals and reference/candidate metrics explicitly named above; every phase, point, prefix and window separately. Both abs and fixed engineering-normalized thresholds.
gate_classification.CONDITIONAL: Only measured-source-driven reduced-TR network predictions after listed prerequisites; configured-source identity remains independently HARD. On failed actual g/R any canonical-input physics/predictions are diagnostic and cannot qualify actual input.
gate_classification.DIAGNOSTIC: Different-h PWL jump max/RMSE; actual-TIME source/time-q envelopes; six individual cycle features without individual limits; analytic/synthetic engineering expectations; reduced-model conditioning estimate.
gate_classification.NOT_APPLICABLE: Deleted series DC ammeter voltage-drop/old rank2 closure, candidate13 native internal-observer outputs and vendor-state-architecture equivalence. Record NA with reason, never PASS. Other time steps, control loops and nonlinear features are out of scope.
gate_classification.UNAVAILABLE: No complete native reference or candidate results exist in this draft. Mark NOT_OBSERVED, not PASS/NA/completed.

failure_policy.any_hard_failure: No overall qualification. Preserve every original run/archive/failed receipt; report all independent failures. Do not retune thresholds, delete samples, reorder phases, shift time or fit amplitude. A changed protocol needs a NEW identity, pre-run rationale and fresh run if inputs changed.
failure_policy.admission_failure: Before non-OUT identity/mapping/archive admission, OUT reads remain zero. Malformed data, precision/safety or indeterminate input gives explicit admission FAIL and unavailable downstream checks, never numeric zeros/PASS. After valid admission, ordinary scalar numerical failures retain all independent residual reporting.
failure_policy.source_or_control_prerequisite: Keep source/control hard failure and full independent physical residual reports. Mark dependent reduced predictions diagnostic.
failure_policy.disagreement: Two independent analyses differing in admission, any hard result, units, q or metric definition blocks qualification until explained with fresh immutable receipts.
failure_policy.scope: A complete open-loop PASS would not certify dq/PLL/P/Vac/Vdc/closing/faults or mark all C1 completed.

budget_basis.physics: New L=.01H, h5/2.5us,20ms ramp/full.2s derivation, not example12/old400us limits.440A safety from universal435.936358A prior;10A is only error scale.
budget_basis.engineering_estimate: Pure internal estimates roughly3.3Arms fundamental,+1.1kW,-.26kvar,7.33A peak and.96Arms residual inform scales/discretization limits, not hard targets or commercial data. Native self-refinement must pass unchanged before candidate.
budget_basis.self_contained: All operative physical parameters and acceptance rules are public here; ignored evidence is provenance only.

Mean Pg/Qg/Pdc follows same-h point gates, loss means use reference_self_abs; steady features use candidate_cross_h_abs (pointwise limits remain stricter).
comparison_pairs.candidate_cross_h: Candidate5us versus qualified native2.5us: candidate_cross_h_continuous_all_windows, mean candidate_cross_h_abs and steady candidate_cross_h_abs; jump PWL diagnostic, declared shared-point limits remain hard. Shared points use candidate_cross_h_shared_grid_hard_peak_limits throughout acquisition.

Independently seal execution package, installed software/source/profile/resource guards, non-OUT mapping admission, post-mapping raw archive and two independent numerical analyzers before actual-data use.
